seedrop.protocol.invalid_id.message: The identifier is not a canonical Seedrop v2 identifier.

seedrop.protocol.id_prefix_too_short.message: The identifier prefix is shorter than the protocol minimum.

seedrop.protocol.id_prefix_not_found.message: The identifier prefix did not match a canonical identifier.

seedrop.protocol.id_prefix_ambiguous.message: The identifier prefix matched more than one canonical identifier.

seedrop.protocol.canonical_json_unsuppor.message: The value is outside the canonical JSON data model.

seedrop.protocol.canonical_json_cycle.message: Canonical JSON cannot encode a cyclic value.

seedrop.protocol.canonical_json_invalid_.message: Canonical JSON cannot encode an unpaired Unicode surrogate.

seedrop.protocol.version_invalid.message: The protocol version is missing or malformed.

seedrop.protocol.version_unknown.message: The protocol version is not registered as supported.

seedrop.protocol.version_forward.message: The protocol version is newer than this implementation supports.

seedrop.protocol.migration_graph_invalid.message: The migration graph is ambiguous, cyclic, orphaned, or has a gap.

seedrop.protocol.validation_failed.message: The migrated protocol value failed current-schema validation.

seedrop.protocol.identity_registry_inval.message: The identity registry is malformed or internally inconsistent.

seedrop.protocol.identity_alias_not_foun.message: The identity alias did not resolve to a registered canonical identity.

seedrop.protocol.identity_alias_ambiguou.message: The identity alias resolves to multiple canonical identities and is denied.

seedrop.protocol.health_invalid.message: The HealthEnvelope input is malformed or incomplete.

seedrop.protocol.health_inconsistent.message: The HealthEnvelope summary disagrees with its structured evidence.

seedrop.protocol.health_disagreement_inv.message: The HealthEnvelope disagreement record is malformed or does not preserve a real contradiction.

seedrop.protocol.command_audit_invalid.message: The command audit trail is malformed, incomplete, or internally inconsistent.

seedrop.protocol.command_audit_inconsist.message: The command audit summary disagrees with its canonical audit entries.

seedrop.protocol.command_transition_inva.message: The command phase transition is not permitted by the command protocol.

seedrop.protocol.command_unrecoverable.message: A nonterminal command has no valid recovery path or a terminal command retains one.

seedrop.protocol.lifecycle_state_unknown.message: The lifecycle name or state is not registered by the protocol.

seedrop.protocol.lifecycle_transition_in.message: The lifecycle transition is not permitted by the protocol state model.

seedrop.protocol.trust_state_invalid.message: The orthogonal trust state is malformed or contains an unknown axis value.

seedrop.protocol.repair_receipt_invalid.message: The repair Receipt is malformed, incomplete, or contradicts its outcome.

seedrop.protocol.repair_journal_invalid.message: The append-only repair Receipt journal has a sequence or hash-chain violation.

seedrop.protocol.operational_metrics_inv.message: The operational metrics input is malformed or incomplete.

seedrop.protocol.operational_metrics_inc.message: The operational metrics summary disagrees with its canonical spans.

seedrop.protocol.explanation_trace_inval.message: The field explanation is missing evidence, policy, projection, or typed unknown state.

seedrop.protocol.explanation_trace_incon.message: The field explanation summary disagrees with its canonical evidence trace.

seedrop.protocol.budget_invalid.message: The bounded-output request or candidate accounting is malformed.

seedrop.protocol.budget_insufficient.message: The requested byte budget cannot contain the mandatory truthful envelope.

seedrop.protocol.bounded_scan_exceeded.message: The bounded path scanned more candidates than its declared limit permits.

seedrop.protocol.telemetry_consent_inval.message: The telemetry consent Receipt is malformed or internally inconsistent.

seedrop.protocol.telemetry_export_denied.message: Telemetry export is denied because explicit matching consent is absent or inactive.

seedrop.protocol.telemetry_secret_detect.message: Telemetry export is denied because the payload contains a secret-pattern finding.
